scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server --filter @workspace/valura-ui --filter @workspace/scripts --if-present run typecheck
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build:libs && pnpm run build:ui && pnpm run build:api && pnpm run bundle
